summary: Issue #76: raise only the bounded Host full frozen-diff review budget to 400000 characters so the exact PR #75 diff is reviewable; all independent approval, signing and merge gates remain fail-closed.

components.disposition: Increase the Host-only frozen diff limit from 256000 to 400000 Unicode characters. Keep the generic Git output limit at 100000 and preserve full-content SHA-256 evidence and review_diff_too_large HOLD above the bound.
evidence: PR #75 exact frozen diff has 335668 characters after the existing Git output strip, and is read in full by the new bound without a binary marker or strong secret.
69 focused Host issuer tests passed before this declaration, including 225k, 260k, 385k and 399k admitted patches, 400k payload rejected, and exact full diff plus SHA-256 in the reviewer task.
Ruff and Pyright passed on the code-only candidate; independent Reviewer, original full R9 and remote CI must be revalidated for the final manifest-bearing SHA.
components.verification_level: Focused tests and exact PR #75 diff read passed; final SHA gates pending.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: No reviewer admission for frozen diffs exceeding 400000 characters, binary metadata or sensitive content; identity and clean-tree checks, independent Reviewer, human-approved Host verify_ref, signed merge queue and protected main remain mandatory.
components.rollback_route: Revert this code/test/declaration through a separately reviewed protected GitHub PR; no service restart or production Host installation is part of this change.

components.disposition: Declare exact changed paths and review, rollback and veto requirements; no runtime policy change.
evidence: The manifest covers all three changed paths and is checked by the original A.5 gate before push.
components.verification_level: Local and remote A.5 gate required.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Missing path coverage or malformed G1-G4 declaration blocks PR integration.
components.rollback_route: Revert this declaration together with its code change.

g1.necessity: PR #75 has a real 335668-character committed diff, above the previous 256000-character Host-only cap. A bounded increase is required to permit complete independent review rather than bypassing Host admission.

g2.authority_owner: HostVerifyAuthority freezes exact lane/base/head and full diff; an isolated read-only Reviewer evaluates it; authenticated Web human approval and the Host issuer alone can issue verify_ref.
g2.non_duplication: No new signer, no alternate approval or CI bypass. Only the existing Host-specific size budget changes; the generic Git limit and every existing veto remain unchanged.

model_evidence: Reproduced the PR #75 failure at 256000 characters and verified the exact full 335668-character frozen diff is admitted at 400000 without truncation.
Focused Host issuer tests cover accepted near-limit full-content review, exact SHA-256 and over-limit fail-closed rejection; Ruff and Pyright passed before this declaration.
Final candidate must independently repeat Reviewer PASS P0/P1=0, original full R9 exit0, A.5, privacy and remote CI.
g3.recovery_or_reason: Frozen diff over 400000 characters, binary metadata, strong secrets, identity drift or reviewer failure must remain HOLD. Do not truncate evidence, forge a signed receipt or use Actions status as a Host signature.

g4.rollback: Use an independently reviewed protected revert PR. No data migration, Host installation, deployment or restart is authorized in this prerequisite.
verification: Independent Reviewer PASS P0/P1=0 on the final manifest-bearing SHA
Original complete bash scripts/ci_gate.sh exit0 on that exact SHA
A.5 structured declaration, privacy and all required GitHub PR CI successful
